description: This file defines the `SimpleAuthenticationServer` class, which extends `AmqpServiceBase` and handles AMQP connection setup, including processing remote open frames, establishing links, and handling authentication-related logic for clients that connect using SASL. It is part of the org.eclipse.hono.service.auth.impl package, indicating its role in authentication service implementation within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: SimpleAuthenticationServer
classes.description: A final class extending `AmqpServiceBase` that manages AMQP connections for client authentication via SASL. It processes connection open frames, manages link attachments, and supports authentication workflow with integration into the Hono framework.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Overrides the setter to initialize specific configuration properties for the service.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service, which is a constant 'auth'.

methods.name: setRemoteConnectionOpenHandler
methods.description: Sets handlers for connection session, sender open, disconnect, close, and open events on the AMQP connection.

methods.name: processRemoteOpen
methods.description: Handles the remote open AMQP frame, checks for ADDRESS_AUTHZ capability, and adds authorities if applicable.

methods.name: handleReceiverOpen
methods.description: Handles a link receiving request, rejects it with an error, and closes the receiver.

methods.name: handleSenderOpen
methods.description: Handles a request to establish a sender link, validates resource identifiers, checks client authentication, and delegates to endpoint handler.
